name: Palm Beach
kitchen_profile: fine dining rooms and private chefs
intro: Palm Beach is the most demanding dining address in Florida. The island's grand resorts run multiple outlets at a standard few kitchens anywhere match; the private clubs plate for members who dine in-house half the week; Worth Avenue and Royal Poinciana Plaza keep adding rooms cooked by nationally known chefs; and behind the hedges, private chefs shop for households that entertain nightly through season.

Supplying the island means holding specs without excuses: produce staged by ripeness for menus planned days out, flawless specialty items — the microgreens, edible flowers, and rare fruit that finish a plate — and delivery timing that respects service entrances and the island's rhythm. We cross the bridge on the morning run, about forty-five minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse, every day of the year that kitchens cook — which on this island is all of them.
route_note: About 45 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse, crossing to the island on the morning run — resort and club docks receive before service prep.

faqs_unique.q: Can you meet resort and private club produce standards on Palm Beach?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Standing orders hold size, trim, and ripeness specs, substitutions are flagged before they ship, and specialty items ride every daily truck — island kitchens are built into the route, not an exception to it.

faqs_unique.q: Do you supply private chefs on the island?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Private chefs order the same catalog as restaurants — no minimums, split cases, and specialty produce — with delivery timed to household schedules.

cta_text: Tell us your standards for resort service, private clubs, fine dining, or catered events, and we will help build a Palm Beach produce plan with the right quality, timing, and communication.
